extracted.name: Fresh Tomato Salad
extracted.description: This tomato, cucumber, and pepper salad is popping with flavor thanks to a full cup of fresh herbs, a generous amount of garlic, and a splash of vinegar.
instruction_lines: Toss tomatoes, onion, cucumber, bell pepper, basil, parsley, garlic, and vinegar in a large bowl until well combined. Season with salt and pepper.
Cover and chill in the refrigerator for 15 minutes before serving.
